title: Battle of the Salween River
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of the Salween River", at revision 1370602095, opens: "The Battle of the Salween River was fought in September 1718 close to the Nagqu in Tibet, between an expedition of the Qing dynasty to Lhasa and a Dzungar Khanate force that blocked its path." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q4502462, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1718 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
